usedFor: 3Scribe finishes transcription jobs and HubSpot keeps the deals, so “Job Complete” can feed “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Job Complete” in 3Scribe, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The finished job is the cue to note the transcript on the deal that is waiting for it.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the deal ID, and “Job Complete” in 3Scribe is polling, so updates land after a scheduled check.
